title: Pensieve session digest
description: What one session contributes to threads, without its transcript text. Built on the device from the session, then stored locally or in the cloud.

components.description: The episodes of the session: runs of exchanges on one theme. Each one can be a thread on its own, and components join into threads.

id.description: The session id and the index: <session id>#<index>.

turns.description: First and end turn of the component, end exclusive.

words.description: The most used content words of the component. Words, not sentences.

session_id.description: The session's id in its agent, for example a Claude Code session id.

source.description: The agent that made the session: claude, codex, qwen, or a web or app source.

started_at.description: When the session started, as the transcript says it.

ended_at.description: When the session was last written.

summary.description: What the session did and where it stands, in at most 80 words.

steps_left.description: Work the session says is still to do. Empty when nothing is left.

closing_signal.description: Set when the session says nothing is left. The quote is the sentence that says so.

key.description: The canonical key: org/repo#n for a pull request, KEY-n for a ticket, the branch name, or the normalized URL. One key, one entity.

ref.description: The link as the session wrote it.

count.description: How often the session mentions it.
